column1: # Prewarm seed list (shipped in the app, next to shader_map.tsv). Rows: S<TAB>shader key<TAB>stage / R<TAB>render pipeline key (pso_skey hex) / C<TAB>compute shader key.

# Recorded on an iPhone 18 Pro Max from the owner's play (update 13.0.5 v2031616): Documents/pso_user.tsv as copied on 2026-11-13, with no list in the app (the list was empty until now), 10303 rows: 9169 S, 1128 R, 6 C. No log.txt came with it, so the build, the settings and the number of starts are not known: its R rows carry the border field (1024 hex digits), which release 1 and older hosts did not write (a host of the X1.0 line wrote them), and every key is a library of the profile's 13.0.5 shader map at the stage the row gives.

# The S rows are the libraries its program creation and draws loaded (9169 of the shader map's 35012); the R rows are the render pipelines its draws built; the C rows are the compute shaders it dispatched. Row order = first-use order; do not sort. Checked with dm/tools/pso_seed.py check: no row refused.
# The operation mode, Picture Stretch and the host's upscaling and edge smoothing change no pipeline key: they are the host's present, and a row's pipeline key (pso_skey) holds no picture size.

# Grown on 2026-11-15 from a second iPhone 18 Pro Max play session (about 9 min, build 431d5d18; the phone's Documents/pso_user.tsv, which holds only what the shipped list lacked): 5963 rows (3159 S, 2797 R, 7 C). That session compiled 1,553 bases in play (103 s on all threads), with pipeline stalls up to about 1 s.

# Grown on 2026-11-16 from a third iPhone 18 Pro Max session (about 4.5 min, build 29dcbb4d; the phone's Documents/pso_user.tsv, which keeps earlier sessions' rows too): 1016 rows (476 S, 540 R, 0 C) this list did not hold. That session compiled 406 bases in play, its longest such frame about 90 ms.

# Grown on 2026-11-17 from the same iPhone 18 Pro Max's Documents/pso_user.tsv after runs on chain ae1dd68dc11c builds (7514 lines, every one accepted by pso_seed.py check): 535 rows (247 S, 287 R, 1 C) this list did not hold. The phone already prepares these at every start from its own list, so its prepare step reads the same lines as before; they go here so the next build's archive holds their layout bases (pso_offline.py), which a first start after a shader-chain change or a fresh install otherwise compiles on the device.
